about.text: A salty brined cheese made from cow milk.Also named "Kučki sir", made in Southern Montenegro city of Podgorica.

sources.text: Montenegrin white brined cheese; Kučki sir is a separate Kuči cheese, so the alias was dropped; Wikipedia URL did not resolve
